resources.string: No DeepSeek Search key is configured (Settings → AI settings → Web search → DeepSeek Search key; leave it empty to reuse the main model key).
DeepSeek Search key is invalid or unauthorized (HTTP 401/403); check the key in AI settings.
DeepSeek account balance is insufficient (HTTP 402); top up and try again.
The current API address does not support web search (HTTP 404): %1$s. Switch back to https://api.deepseek.com/v1 or choose DuckDuckGo.
DeepSeek Search is rate limited (HTTP 429); try again in a moment.
DeepSeek Search timed out after %1$d s (slow network or queued server request).
DeepSeek Search returned data that could not be parsed.
⚠️ DeepSeek Search did not succeed; fell back to DuckDuckGo. Reason: %1$s
